sentences.en: To be human we must transcend our animal nature.
sentences.zh: 为了成为人类，我们必须超越动物的本性。

sentences.en: Individuals have international duties which transcend the national obligations of obedience.
sentences.zh: 个人有超越国家服从义务的国际责任。

sentences.en: This is a universal truth that transcends time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个超越时间的普遍真理。
